The programmatic guards in edit_task (line 242), add_task (line 163) and list_tasks (line 272) still accept a boolean priority because True == 1 in Python, so the importable API can write store files that TaskStore.load now rejects; the CLI is safe because argparse coerces to int. Mirroring the bool exclusion the store guard uses would make every rejected shape consistent.

The type validation this commit adds is inconsistent: the id guard explicitly rejects booleans, but the priority guard counts booleans as members of (1, 2, 3) because True == 1 and False == 0 in Python, so a store carrying "priority": true loads as priority 1 instead of failing with the documented RuntimeError. A follow-up test pinning "priority": true as rejected is advisable once the fix lands.
